nodes.label: sendMessage
nodes.summary: Resolves recruiter/company participants from candidate, authorizes membership, self-heals conversation_participants, inserts message, fans out notification to the other party.

nodes.label: sendRecruitorMessage
nodes.summary: Inserts message into the 'recruito' conversation for a candidate, creating it if absent.

nodes.label: getConversations
nodes.summary: Aggregates conversations for current user via participants, hydrates candidate/job/company/profiles using admin client.

nodes.label: getCandidateConversation
nodes.summary: Reads a candidate's client/recruito conversation with messages+sender profiles.

nodes.label: getUnreadMessageCount
nodes.summary: Counts messages newer than last_read_at not sent by the user.

nodes.label: conversations/messages/participants (tables)
nodes.summary: Supabase messaging tables: conversations, messages, conversation_participants.
